subject: english
question:
Read the sentence carefully and select the synonym of the underlined word from the given alternatives.

The Television show was hosted by a young and __vivacious__ woman called Laura.
solution:
The correct answer is: Energetic.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vivacious"** means lively, animated, and full of energy. (जीवंत)

 
 
• **Example: **Her **vivacious **personality made her the life of the party.
 
 
 
• **"Energetic" **refers to someone who is very active, vigorous, and full of energy. (ऊर्जावान)
 
 
• **Example: **He is an **energetic **young man who loves playing sports.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'vivacious' **is **'energetic'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Liberal **(उदार): Open to new behavior or opinions and willing to discard traditional values.

 
 
• **Example:** She has **liberal **views on education and supports progressive teaching methods.
 
 
 
• **Legendary **(पौराणिक): Remarkable enough to be famous; very well known.
 
 
• **Example: **His **legendary **exploits in battle were known far and wide.
 
 
 
• **Atrocious** (क्रूर): Horrifyingly wicked or of a very poor quality.
 
 
• **Example:** The crime scene was **atrocious **and left everyone in shock.
